title: Create Assortment
content:
# **📝 List of Contents** 📍CLO-SET [Assortment](https://clo-set-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303168765593) is the ultimate tool for showcasing your entire collection. 1. Enter workroom 2. Create Assortment 3. Review Assortment 4. Mix & Match # **📓 Details** **1\. Enter workroom** --- In the left menu pane, follow these steps: 1. Click the **Browse** icon. 2. Select **Company** at the top of the menu tree. 3. Double-click **Brand** in the main screen. ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54984393652249) 4. Double-click the **Season** in the Brand space.![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54984372340633) 5. Double-click the **Workroom** in the Season space.![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54984393655065) 6. You can view content in the **Workroom.** ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54984393655833) **2\. Create Assortment** --- * Select the Content(s) to move, and click _**Add to Assortment**_. For a single item, click the ⋯ (More) button and choose _**Add to Assortment**_ ; For multiple items, hold Ctrl/Cmd and click _**Assortment**_ from **the floating menu**. * Select an Assortment room to use on the space tree, or create new Assortment. When creating a new Assortment, enter a name on the blank and click _Next_. * All Contents must be uploaded in Workroom first, to be moved to Assortments * User must be Admin or Collaborator to add Content to Assortment. ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54984393656217) | ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54984372349081) ---|--- ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54984372350745) ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54989679943705) _**💡 Note**_ > **You can also create Assortment in season page**
> > 1\. Click ![blobid0.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54989696559257) icon from the 'Season' Space. > 2\. Enter Assortment name and click 'CONFIRM' button. **3\. Review Assortment** --- * Enter the Assortment to start * Adjust the layout with the sizing menu, or hover over the Content to switch **Viewing modes** ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54984372352537) * Switch View Mode option, or hover over the Content to switch **Viewing modes** _The 3D view mode cannot be changed in bulk from the dropdown menu._ ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54984372353561) ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54984393664153) * Switch View By options to adjust the Assortment layout _\- View By**Content** : displays 1 _[_default Colorway thumbnail_](https://clo-set-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303191375129) _of each Content_ _\- View By**Colorway** : displays each Colorway as a separate image_ ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54984372356633) ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54984372357529) * Active the **'Synchronized' camera** at the top menu bar, and hover over any Content to open the Turntable bar. Click the Turntable bar and move the mouse to rotate the designs together ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54984372357913) * To **change the order** of Content(s), click 'Change Order" icon at the menu bar. Click & drag the Contents to adjust the order, and click 'Save As New Order' button. Type in the name of the order, and click 'Save' ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54984372358809) ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776354102553) * Click the **Eye icon** at the bottom of the content and turn off **Show Hidden Colorway** at the top menu bar to view only active colorways, excluding those with the Eye icon disabled. ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54984393670681) ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54984372367385) * You can also click the **Pin icon** to select colorways, then click the **Excel button** at the top to download only the pinned colorways as an Excel file. ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54984393673241)![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54989859660569) * Click **Mix & Match** in the top-right corner to freely combine multiple garments for review. Click **Create a Virtual Showroom** to add garments to a showroom space and display them. ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54984393675161) _**💡 Note**_ > * **You can add Style Content to Assortment in Assortment page** > 1\. Click ![blobid1.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54989679944601) icon and select the desired style to add into Assortment. > 2\. Select the desired style from EXPLORER or add the style you recently worked on from RECENT
> > > ![assortment.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54989696561049)
> > * When content is deleted from the Workroom, it will appear as an unavailable thumbnail in the Assortment.
> > > ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54986851144729)
> > * Colorways created in the **Configurator** are displayed in the **Assortment Room**. > When a newer version is available, a **red dot indicator** appears next to the content, allowing Editors (or higher) to update to the latest version, while Viewers can see the indicator without access to the update action.
> ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54989852711193) | ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54989859663513) > ---|--- **4\. Mix & Match Contents** --- [Mix & Match](https://clo-set-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303205588377) the Contents to review the full outfit #### **1) How to use Mix &Match** 1\. Move the Content you want to Mix&Match to the same Assortment room *You can only select the 3D Contents in the same Assortment room from where you entered the Mix&Match page. 2\. Multi-select the contents by clicking the check box at the top-left side of the respective content 3\. Click the ‘MIX AND MATCH’ Icon on the right top 4\. Load your items by drag-and-dropping into the viewer. ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54798550741273)![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54798550749721) ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54798511745561) ### #### **2) Mixing & Matching Garments** * Drag and drop selected garments into the Mix & Match view * Combine any garments freely without category restrictions * Adjust garment placement to explore different outfit combinations ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54798550758169)![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54798550760985) #### **3) Saving a Scene** * Save the final outfit combination as a **scene** * Saved scenes can be used for later review, feedback, or collaboration ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54798511752089)![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54798511756313) #### **4) Tips** * We recommend using contents that are created with consistent avatars and poses for more promising outcomes. * You can freely add and combine multiple garments to explore different outfit variations.
content_description: Discover how to effectively showcase and manage your clothing collection with CLO-SET's comprehensive assortment creation and review tools.

title: Assortment
content:
# **Objective** ![Icon Pack \(6\).png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778011371673) | 'Assortment' is a Space level for assortment planning & final review. You can also create Virtual Showroom as well as Mix & Match within Assortment. ---|--- 1. Create Assortment / Add Contents 2. Viewing Modes 3. Excel Download 4. Virtual Showroom 5. Mix & Match 6. Assortment Comment 7. Colorway Version Update from Configurator # **Details** ### 1) Create Assortment / Add Contents * Select the Content(s) to move, and click _**Add to Assortment**_. For a single item, click the ⋯ (More) button and choose _**Add to Assortment**_ ; For multiple items, hold Ctrl/Cmd and click _**Assortment**_ from **the floating menu**. * Select an Assortment room to use on the space tree, or create new Assortment. When creating a new Assortment, enter a name on the blank and click _Next_. ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54989580977049) | ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54989580977945) ---|--- ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54989597400729) _**💡 Note**_ > * All Contents must be uploaded in Workroom first, to be moved to Assortments
> * User must be Admin or Collaborator to add Content to Assortment.
> * **You can also create Assortment in season page**
> > 1\. Click ![blobid0.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778020091033) icon from the 'Season' Space. > 2\. Enter Assortment name and click 'CONFIRM' button.
> > * **You can add Style Content to Assortment in Assortment page** > 1\. Click ![blobid1.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778020508569) icon and select the desired style to add into Assortment. > 2\. Select the desired style from EXPLORER or add the style you recently worked on from RECENT
> > > ![assortment.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778027003545)
> > * When content is deleted from the Workroom, it will appear as an unavailable thumbnail in the Assortment.
> > > ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54989829075993) ### 2) Viewing Modes #### ✔️ Viewer Mode Drop Down Menu Quickly switch the viewer option between 2D, 3D, and Render. **Hover over the style** in Assortment Room, and you will see a drop-down menu on the upper right corner. Click to switch viewer modes! ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778027716377) ✔️ By Viewer Mode **2D** | **3D** | **Render** ---|---|--- ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778038351641) | ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778038486681) | ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778021096345) *When viewing in Render mode, selecting a colorway OUTSIDE the viewer will NOT be reflected. *Colorway list is from the original Zprj file. New colorway added from CLO-SET Configurator will not show. To add new colorways, upload a new Zprj file, and move the garment to Assortment room. #### ✔️ Synchronized Camera in Assortment ‘Synchronized Camera’ in Assortment, by allowing users to add multiple Contents in Assortment and view them at the same time with the customized multiview. 1. Select the desired 3D contents and activate 3D Viewers by clicking the 'Viewer' button in the 3D window. 2. When the 3D viewer has been activated, turn on the Synchronized Camera mode by clicking the 'Synchronized' button on the top of the 3D contents. 3. Now, you can review and control multiple 3D contents with the customized multiview at the same time. ※ Note: In accordance with the release of ‘Synchronized Camera’, ‘My bag’ Function will discontinue its service and be replaced from October 5, 2021. #### ✔️ Colorway Show&Hide **Show/Hide** button is available at the bottom of the content section. Select any items you wish to hide, then enable the _**Show Hidden Colorway**_**toggle** at the top to view the content while excluding the hidden items. ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/52950257252889) ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/52950257258521) ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/52950228676249) **Show & Hide visibility control** is also available in **Content Mode** within the Assortment Room. Contents marked as hidden in Content Mode are excluded from the **Excel linesheet.** ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54600626487321) ### ### 3) Excel Download You may utilize [Excel Download](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303209763865) ( ![blobid2.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778028428057)) to export the info of Contents within the Assortment. ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54989829079193) ### 4) Virtual Showroom You may create a [Virtual Showroom](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303178555801) using the 3D Contents within your Assortment. Please follow the link to find detailed guidelines on how to set up your Virtual Showroom. ![Screenshot 2023-09-05 at 1.15.34 PM.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778014153881) ### 5) Simple Mix & Match [Mix & Match](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303205588377) your Contents to review the full style. You can try mixing up the combination to see which designs go well together. ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54989829080601)![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54989845354265) ### 6) Assortment Comment * Commenting is available at the Assortment level. * Please follow the [hyperlink](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303171263641) for more details including Permissions. ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778039817497) ### 7) Colorway Version Update from Configurator Colorways created in the **Configurator** are displayed in the **Assortment Room**. When a newer version is available, a **red dot indicator** appears next to the content, allowing Editors (or higher) to update to the latest version, while Viewers can see the indicator without access to the update action. ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54600635531801) ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54600626489625)
content_description: The purpose of this webpage is to provide a comprehensive guide for users on how to effectively utilize the 'Assortment' feature for assortment planning, final reviews, and creating virtual showrooms within the platform.

title: Console - Permission Management
content: ## 📝 **List of Contents** 📍 Learn how to manage user access and permissions in the Admin Console. * Access Admin Console * Search * Change Permission * Remove Access > ###### _Permission:![admin.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778737061017) Group Admin, Group Operator_ # **📓 Details** **•Access Admin Console** --- 1\. Enter [Dashboard](https://www.style.clo-set.com/) and click **Console** button from the left navigation menu. 2\. Admin Console shows the **Summary** , **Billing** , **Data Intelligence** , **Activity Log** , **Settings** , and **Developer Page**. 3\. Click **Permission Management** from the tree menu. ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54931053007257) _**💡 Notes**_ > ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54931061560857) #### **•Search** --- **1\. Search by keyword (Name & Email)** * Enter the user’s **name or email** in the keyword field, then click **Search**. * You can check the searched user’s **permission details** in the **Total** section below. ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54931061561881) **2\. Search by space (including subspace is available)** * Click **Select a Space** in the Space section. * In the pop-up window, choose the space you want from the **menu tree** , then click **Next**. * Confirm that the correct space is selected, then click **Search**. * You can check the searched users’ **permission details** in the **Total** section below. ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54931053016089) *Search filter is not provided to Group Operator. Only Group Admin can use the 'Space' filter. **3\. Search by content** * Click the toggle button in the **Content** section to switch it from **Off** to **On**. * Click **Select a Content** and choose the content you want to search for. * Confirm that the correct content is selected, then click **Search**. * You can check the searched users’ **permission details** in the **Total** section below. ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54931061567641) ### **•Change Permission** --- ##### **1\. Collaborator ↔ Admin** * ##### **Hover mouse** over the **Space** and **Permission** area. * ##### Click the **•••** button that appears next to the permission. * ##### Select **Change to Admin** or **Change to Collaborator**. **![mceclip4.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778722435225)** **2\. Viewer ↔ Editor** * **Hover mouse** over the **Space** and **Permission** area. * Click the **•••** button that appears next to the permission. * Select **Change** to open the **Change Permission** pop-up. * Click the **drop-down menu** and choose the permission (**Can edit** or **Can view**). * Click **Confirm** , and the permission will be updated. **![mceclip5.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778769053337)** **•Remove Access** --- ##### **1.****Delete user (Single/Multiple) - Remove access from all spaces** > Removes the selected user’s **access to all assigned spaces**. * Click the **checkbox** on the left side of the user information to select the user. * Click the **Delete** button. * Select **OK** in the pop-up window to remove the user’s access completely. ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54931053023513) **2\. Remove access by space** **\- Remove access from a specific space or content** * **Hover mouse** over the **Space** and **Permission** area. * Click the **•••** button that appears next to the permission. * Select **Remove** to revoke the user’s access to that space. ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54931053024665)
content_description: This webpage provides a comprehensive guide on managing user access and permissions within the Admin Console, including instructions for accessing the console, searching for users, changing permissions, and removing access.

title: Share Space
content:
# **📝 List of Contents** 📍 Share how to learn spaces, such as Workroom, Company, or Brand. * Share Workroom (![workroom.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776498983321)) * Share Company / Brand * Permission System # **📓 Details** **• Share Workroom**(![workroom.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776498983321)) via Email --- ### ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54913663425049) 1. Click **Browse** , then select the **Workroom** you want to share from the menu tree. 2. Once in the **Workroom** , click the **Share** button on the right pane. (![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776501122585)) 3. Enter the email of the recipient, and select permission (Editor or Viewer) * Find details on Editor/Viewer on 'Permissions System' below 4. Click 'Share', and recipient will receive an email notification _💡**Alternative: Share via Link**_ > ##### Turn on **Share with Link** and select **Anyone can view** to publish the Workroom and share it via URL. Anyone with the link can view the content, but only **Group Members** can download.
> > ##### Download access for link-shared content is limited to **Group Members only**. > Anyone with the link can still **view** , but only **Group Members can download** , even when **Enable Download** is turned on.
> > ### ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776559536281) **• Share Company / Brand** --- ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54913674648345) 1. Click **Browse** , then select the **Company** or **Brand** you want to share from the menu tree. 2. Once in the **Company** or **Brand** , click the **Share** button on the right pane. (![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776501122585)) 3. On the right pane, enter the email of the recipient, and select permission (Admin or Collaborator) * Find details on Editor/Viewer on 'Permissions System' below 4. Click 'Invite', and recipient will receive an email notification **• Permission System**[**(Download guide)**](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776532401689) --- * CLO-SET has 4-level permission system: Admin, Collaborator, Editor, and Viewer * **Admin & Collaborator** permissions are granted per higher-level spaces (Company and Brand) * **Editor & Viewer** permissions are granted at lower-level spaces (Workroom, Assortment, Content) * Line and Season spaces do not have granted permissions. Anyone with access to Company or Brand will have access to Line/Season spaces within. | ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776517555481) | ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776534261913) ---|---|--- * Find more details on the [**Group Setup Instructions**](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776532401689) guide. | ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776549307161) | ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45793207603481) ---|---|---
content_description: This web page provides a comprehensive guide on how to share Workroom, Company, and Brand spaces, including details on the permission system and sharing methods via email or link.

title: Group
content: # **Objective** Understand the CLO-SET Group structure. Understanding the Group structure and operation is an initial step in collaborating with your team using CLO-SET. 1. What is a 'Group'? 2. Pricing Plan 3. Group Hierarchy 4. Permission 5. Company Transfer 6. Leave a Group # **Details** ### 1) What is a ‘Group’? ![Screenshot 2023-07-28 at 11.19.41 AM.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776072787097) When a new user signs up in CLO-SET, a new Group is created. Group is the highest level Space in CLO-SET, and within each Group are Spaces such as Company - Brnad - Line - Season etc. You may invite other teammates to your Group, or be invited to another user's Group for collaboration. CLO-SET operates on a Group level. That is, Structure, Permission, and Pricing Plan is determined per Group. ### ### 2) Pricing Plan ![Screenshot 2023-07-28 at 1.42.04 PM.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776054299033) CLO-SET Pricing Plan is applied to each Group. You may check which Plan the Group is using on your dashboard. Please check out our Pricing Page to learn about different options. ### 3) Group Hierarchy ![Screenshot 2023-07-28 at 1.47.26 PM.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776090181913) CLO-SET Group consists of different Spaces in a hierarchy. Within each Group can be multiple Company, Brand, Line, Season, Workroom, and Assortment Spaces. You may invite or share each Space with your teammates. Learn more about creating Spaces [here](https://clo-set-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303240419865). ### 4) Permission CLO-SET has a total of 5 Permission levels to provide for advanced security control options on your assets. Please check out this article to see different types of [Permissions](https://clo-set-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303153376537). Permission is also applicable to each Group. For example, you may be a Company Admin within 1 Group, but a Viewer on another Group. ### 5) Company Transfer * Permission: ![admin.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776081893657) Group Admin / Company Admin Company Transfer allows users to transfer Company between different Groups. This can be an alternative option when your Group Admin changed and you need to change the Group Admin to a different account. ![Screenshot 2023-07-28 at 2.03.05 PM.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776071175833) 1\. Go to 'Company Setting'. 2\. Click 'Company Transfer' and enter the Admin email of the recipient Group. 3\. Admin of the recipient Group must accept the request to complete the transfer. Log in to CLO-SET to accept. * * Please be noted that the RECIPIENT of the Company must be on Premium Plan. ### 6) Leave a Group * Permission: Company Admin / Collaborator / Editor / Viewer / Group Operator Members of the Group can choose to leave a Group without further actions from Admin. * Select the Group from the drop-down menu at the top left corner. * Go to 'Workspace' or 'Console' tab on the left. (Menu options may differ based on your permission) ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776090704025) ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776105889177) * Click 'Leave This Group' at the bottom. ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776106032153) * Confirm the action by clicking 'OK'. Make sure to check the name of the Group you are leaving. ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776082826265) * Upon leaving the Group, Group Admin and Group Operator will receive notifications. *Group Admin cannot leave the Group. *Once you click 'OK', you may NOT undo the action. Please reach out to Group Admin to regain access. ### 🔔 Policy Update (2026.01.27) : Group Activation for New Users Joining via Invite or Share **New users** who sign up for CLO-SET **via a Group invitation or shared content** will have their personal Group **deactivated by default**. If needed, users can activate their own Group by selecting **Create My Group** from the Group Switcher. ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54600755328793) ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54606352390041)
content_description: The purpose of this web page is to provide a comprehensive understanding of the CLO-SET Group structure, including its hierarchy, pricing plans, permissions, and collaboration features, to facilitate effective teamwork.

title: Simple Mix & Match

title: YouTube Tutorial: CLO-SET in 5 minutes!

title: Account Deletion & Subscription Cancellation
content:
**Q1 : How do I delete my account?** **A1 : There are two ways to delete your CLO-SET account.** You can either wait until your current subscription expires and then delete your account, or choose to cancel your subscription immediately and delete your account right away. **Note:** Once your account is deleted, all data will be permanently removed and cannot be recovered. * * * ## **Objective** Understand how to delete account on CLO-SET. 1. Delete account after unsubscribing current license/plan 2. Delete account immediately ## **Details** #### **1) Delete Account after unsubscribing current licenses** 1. Visit “My Page” from [**CLO-SET**](https://style.clo-set.com/account/myaccount) to start the account deletion process. ![mceclip1.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54134461458073) 2\. Click "Delete My Account" button at the bottom of "My Page". ![mceclip2.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54134454111769) 3-1. Click "Delete" button to further proceed. ![mceclip4.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54134454112281) > 💡 **Note:** If account is using Enterprise license on CLO / Marverlous Design or, account is seller
> > on CONNECT and there is an unsettled amount remaining, you won't be able to delete
> > the account directly. Please click **"Contact US"** button for further assistance. ![mceclip3.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54134461460761) 4\. Current license/plan will be displayed and must be canceled before account deletion. * All **CLO** and **MD** licenses, as well as any **CLO-SET paid plans** , must be unsubscribed in the area marked as **①**. * **You must leave any CLO-SET groups** in the area marked as **②**. > 💡 **Note:** After canceling your licenses and plans, you will still be able to use the service until their expiration date. The “Next” button will become active only **after the end date**. #### ![mceclip6.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54134454119193) #### **2) Delete Account immediately** 1. To immediately delete the account without waiting for the license/plan end date, click the “Delete My Account” button in the area marked as ③ > 💡 **Note:** Please note that any active paid plans and associated data will be immediately terminated and deleted upon proceeding. Make sure to review carefully before continuing. ![mceclip7.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54134461463705) 2\. Account will be deleted immediately after email verification and a short survey are completed. ![mceclip8.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54134461466521)![mceclip9.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54134461468185) * * * **Important Notes on Account Deletion** 1) Once deleted, the account cannot be recovered, and sign-in will no longer be possible on both the website and software. 2) After deletion, content and posts previously created will display the user name as follows: * If the email address is shown: **“Deleted Account”** will be displayed instead. * If the account name is shown: it will remain as **{account name}** , as in the case of CLO-SET. *
content_description: This web page provides a clear guide on how to delete your CLO-SET account, outlining both immediate and subscription-based cancellation methods along with important considerations regarding data loss.

title: Didn’t receive the verification email during sign-up?
content: **Q1: I am not receiving the verification email. What should I do?** **A1:** Double check the email address typed in. Make sure you do not have typos. **A2:** If you are using your company email, please contact your IT team for any firewall setups. The verification email may be blocked from your company's email server settings, even before reaching your spam inbox. **A3:** If you are still experiencing the issue, please [submit a request](https://clovf-hc.zendesk.com/hc/requests/new) for a manual verification process. **A4: Student Email** \- Some school domains block external emails. Please check if your school domain is connected to the verification email on [Verify Email Address Link](https://www.verifyemailaddress.org/). If you see the result as "Connecting did not work", please ask your school admin (especially the technical division) to check if you could receive the verification email from [noreply@clo-set.com](mailto:noreply@clo-set.com) **A5: Gmail Account -** Mark incorrectly classified emails as Not spam. Go to your spam folder and open the email from [noreply@clo-set.com](mailto:noreply@clo-set.com). Click on the 'Report not spam' button at the top. Gmail uses machine learning to recognize spam. So you need to mark CLO-SET emails as not spam manually to let Gmail learn your behavior. **Note :** Even if your email address has not been verified yet, you can still log in to CLO-SET. After logging in, you can complete the email verification process at any time again. ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54138028055193) * * * **Q2: I signed up using a Google account and did not see an email verification step. Is this an issue?** **A1:** No, this is not an issue. If you sign up using a Google account, your email address is automatically verified, so no additional email verification step is required. ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54138106505369)
content_description: This web page provides guidance on troubleshooting issues with receiving verification emails and clarifies the automatic verification process for Google account sign-ups.

title: How do I change my email address?
content: ## **Q1 : How can I change my email address?** **A1 :** Go to **My Page** and click **Change Email** to update your email address. * * * **Q2 : I see a message saying that my email cannot be changed. Why is this happening?** **A2 :** There may be several reasons why you are unable to change your email address. Your issue may fall under one of the cases below. 1. **Email address already in use** 2. **Unable to change email** 3. **Account region mismatch** (*CLO / CLO-SET only) 4. **Email change will affect the plan type** (*CLO only) For detailed explanations and step-by-step solutions, please refer to the [troubleshooting guide](https://clovf-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45261749919129) . * * * ## **Objective** Understand how to change your email address, and the following implications of changing your account email. 1. [Change Email vs. Email Switching](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303201935897-Change-Email-from-CLO-SET#h_01J0QNCTQSZMYFJFQ43ZPVV7T3) 2. [Ground Rules for Change Email](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303201935897-Change-Email-from-CLO-SET#01J14B22H7ABR174MHJYQN61F6) 3. [Change Email Guide](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303201935897-Change-Email-from-CLO-SET#h_01J0QPN98R7YZPTP1RMBQ3QSFP) * General Flow * Confirm License Info * Troubleshooting 4. [Change Email Implications](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303201935897-Change-Email-from-CLO-SET#h_01J0QPN6FK48VSWVVB87JZJ82Y) 5. [Troubleshooting](https://clovf-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45261749919129) ## **Details** #### **1) Change Email vs. Email Switching** **Change Email** | **VS** | **Email Switch** **(when the 'new email' is already on CLO-SET)** ---|---|--- ![change email.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54139774805401) | ![emai switch.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54139773992217) * **Change Email** : Change your CLO-SET Integrated account email. Changing the CLO-SET email will also update the connected CLO & Marvelous Designer license information if any. Please find instructions below on the [Change Email Guide](https://clovf-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45261749831577). * **Email Switch** : Email Switching is for users hoping to connect their existing CLO or Marvelous Designer license with a different CLO-SET email account. This feature is not available yet. For such requests, please [submit a ticket](https://clo-set-hc.zendesk.com/hc/requests/new?ticket_form_id=9530590112143). #### **2) Ground Rules for Change Email** * Your CONNECT account is the same as CLO-SET account. The two services share account information. * Accounts registered as Enterprise or Academic on CLO software cannot use 'Change email' feature. * If the email address you want to change TO is already registered in CLO-SET, you cannot override an existing account. Please refer to the [troubleshooting guide](https://clovf-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45261749919129) for further steps. #### **3) Change Email Guide** 1\. Visit 'my page' from [**CLO-SET**](https://style.clo-set.com/account/myaccount) , [**CLO**](https://clo3d.com/accounts), or [**Marvelous Designer**](https://www.marvelousdesigner.com/mypage/account) to start the change email process ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54139773993625) 2\. If your CLO-SET account is also active on CLO or Marvelous Designer service, please note that the account information on respective services will also be updated. Click 'OK' to proceed. ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54139773994393) 3\. On the following screen, please type in the new email address to be used. Click 'Send' to receive an email with the verification code. [Not receiving verification emails?](https://clovf-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45261750460569) 4\. Once the verification is complete, you will see the final modal on the right. Please go back to the sign-in page, and start signing in with the new email address. Please also carefully read the implications of changing your emails. ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54139773995545) ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54139773997977) 5\. **[Important]** Active License found under your New Email Address If the there is/are active CLO or Marvelous Designer license under the 'new email' you typed in, your CLO-SET account will now be integrated with those License information. One of the two modals below will be displayed with the list of Licenses to be connected. ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54139774811289)![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54139774003737)![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54139774004121)![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54139774004377) ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54139774006937) *Signing again with your current email ([abc@clo3d.com](mailto:abc@clo3d.com)) will create a 2nd CLO-SET account after changing your account email to [newemail@clo3d.com](mailto:newemail@clo3d.com). *If you would like to keep the license under the current email ([abc@clo3d.com](mailto:abc@clo3d.com)), please use the '[Email Switching](https://clovf-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45261749831577)' feature instead. 6\. Troubleshooting Should you experience an error while attempting to change the email address, please find the [Troubleshooting Guide](https://clovf-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45261749919129) for instructions. Note : #### **4) Change Email Implications** * **Impact on Request and Community History** Changing your email address will disconnect the history of your requests and community activities. This includes comments, request history, and other related data, which will no longer be associated with your new email address. * **Account Type** Enterprise user email changes are not allowed. Please make the change through your Company ID. It is possible to change your personal email to a corporate email, but the account type will not change. If you wish to change your account type from personal to enterprise, please contact our support team. * Additionally, please review what to consider when changing emails for each product: [CLO](https://clovf-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45261749919129) / [Marvelous Designer](https://clovf-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45261749919129) / [CONNECT](https://clovf-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45261749919129) / [CLO-SET](https://clovf-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45261749919129) ### [CLO] * **Billing Email Matching** If your billing email matches your CLO-SET account email, it will automatically update when you change your CLO-SET email. However, if they don't match, your billing email will remain unchanged. * **Plan Type Considerations** If you have an active license and changing your email address affects your plan type (e.g., student to individual or vice versa), you won't be able to proceed with the email change. You may need to retain your current email or consider cancelling your subscription to initiate the change. If you don't have an active license and changing your email address affects your plan type (e.g., student to individual or vice versa), your user type will automatically change with the email change. (Individual↔️Student) However, be aware that this may impact the available subscription plans. Only plans corresponding to your updated user type will be available for purchase. * **Change Email between CLO global and China Websites** When you change your email on the CLO Global website, you cannot change it to the email registered on the CLO China website. ### [Marvelous Designer] * **Billing Email Matching** If your billing email matches your CLO-SET account email, it will automatically update when you change your CLO-SET email. However, if they don't match, your billing email will remain unchanged. * **License** Changing your email does not affect your license. You can change your email even if you have an active license, and you will be able to continue using your license with the new email. ### [CLO-SET / CONNECT] * **Billing Email Matching** The registered payment information on Stripe will NOT be updated automatically. To change the email address of your Stripe account, please visit Stripe (<https://stripe.com/>). * **Account Data** Users can continue accessing the Groups and uploaded files they have permission to. Please note that your account name will not be updated. To change your account name, please visit [https://style.clo-set.com/account/myaccount.](https://style.clo-set.com/account/myaccount) #### **5) Troubleshooting** For various reasons, email changing is not supported systematically for certain accounts. Please follow the [**Troubleshooting Guide**](https://clovf-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45261749919129) to reach the support team. * * * Before changing your email address in CLO-SET, please consider these factors to ensure a smooth transition and avoid any unexpected issues. If you have any questions or need further assistance, feel free to [Contact Us](https://clo-set-hc.zendesk.com/hc/requests/new?ticket_form_id=9530590112143).
content_description: This web page provides a comprehensive guide on how to change your email address, including potential issues and implications associated with the process.

title: Component Library (Block Pattern, Fabric, Trim)
content: # **📝 List of Contents** | ![Size=2XL 200, RVS=OFF.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45777846899865) | * Company Library is a space for managing **commonly used assets** * Company Library is a special type of Workroom, where users can **upload** Contents ---|---|--- 📍 Learn how to setup a digital library for shared components & reusable assets. For instructions on how to manage project-based design files, visit [HERE](https://clo-set-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303176120217) * Company Library * Setup Company Library * Invite Team # **📓 Details** **• *Company Library** --- ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45777856445593) ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45777847222553) * For every Company-level space in CLO-SET, there is a **Company Library** space for managing commonly used assets. Here, you can upload common assets shared throughout the team/season **• Setup Company Library** --- ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45777856858137) * In Company Library, create **Workrooms** for managing your shared assets. For example, create a Workroom for Block Pattern, Avatar, Fabric, and Trim as displayed below. You can create Child-Workrooms within each Workroom for a more detailed setup * Alternatively, upload **Content(s)** directly to the Company Library * Click **'+ New'** button on the top to create Workrooms or upload Content(s) **• Invite Team**(optional) --- * Once the setup is complete, start inviting Teammates to access the Company Libary ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45777857054617) 1. **Share To People** : invite other CLO-SET users as Editor/Viewer * Enter the email, select permission, and click 'Share'. Invitee will receive an email notification 2. **Share with Link** : publish the Workroom for anyone with link to access the space (CLO-SET account required) * Turn on 'Anyone with link can view' option. Please note that this will publish your workroom. Be aware of security risks of the URL being passed onto external parties 3. **Accessible People** : Anyone with [Admin/Collaborator permission](https://clo-set-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303153376537) to the Company will be able to access the Company Library automatically * Click the upward arrow to view the list of people with access ### **📝****** Share with Link Policy update Update (December 2025) The **Enable Download** option has been updated. * **Share with Link remains available** , and **guests can still view content** as before. * **Downloads are limited to group members only**. * Even if **Enable Download** is enabled, **non–group members can view content but cannot download.**
content_description: The purpose of this web page is to provide a comprehensive guide for setting up and managing a Company Library within CLO-SET, facilitating the sharing and organization of commonly used assets among team members.

title: Permission
content: # **Objective** **![Screenshot 2024-01-16 at 2.27.55 PM.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45777847835289)**| ![Screenshot 2024-01-16 at 2.28.05 PM.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45777868204185) ---|--- **The following is the permission hierarchy of CLO-SET.** Users can be given any one of the following access rights, in descending order of access: 1. Admin & Collaborator 2. Editor & Viewer 3. Group Operator 4. Updates on Editor/Viewer (Dec 2023) 5. [**Setup Guide** ](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45777833207321)\- find PDF guide at the end of the article To view permission by space and functionality, please refer to Permission Table by Space # **Details** ### 1) Admin & Collaborator ![Screenshot 2024-01-16 at 2.40.00 PM.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45777848354585) **Permission** | **Admin** | **Collaborator** ---|---|--- **Space** | Group, Company, Brand | Company, Brand **Granted by** | Invited by Admin **Access** | Can create/edit/delete Spaces & Styles. Can invite Collaborators and share to Editors/Viewers. | Can **ONLY** create/edit/delete Season(Line) and below. Can share the workroom & Company Library to Editors/Viewers. **Description** | * Group Admin: All access. Can create/edit/delete all Spaces and invite users to any level of Space. Subject to payment for the entire Group. * Company Admin: Can create/edit/delete Company and below. Invite users to the Company. * Brand Admin: Can create/edit/delete Brand and below. Invite users to the Brand. | * Company Collaborator: Can access all features for Company and below. But can ONLY create/edit/delete/share Season (Line) and below. Can share Company Library, Workroom and below. * Brand Collaborator: Can access all features for Brand and below. But can ONLY create/edit/delete Season (Line) and below. Can share Company Library, Workroom and below. > 💡 **Note:** In the group hierarchy, only one group admin is allowed. ### 2) Editor & Viewer ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45777868985881) **Permission** | **Editor** | **Viewer** ---|---|--- **Space** | Workroom, Assortment, Style (Content) **Granted by** | Shared by Admin/Collaborator/Editor **Access** | Have authority to edit and share Workroom/Assortment/Style that they are shared to. | Can only view the Workroom/Assortment/Style that has been shared. Group members can select to grant download/upload options to Viewers when sharing Workroom/Style. **Description** | | ![Screen_Shot_2022-12-04_at_10.10.56_PM.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45777858259865) * Enable Download: With the download option, Viewers can download files, tech packs, and rendering images. * Enable Upload: With the upload option, Viewers can upload 3D assets and attachments to Workroom/Style. Check out the below article for details on this new feature. [https://support.clo-set.com/hc/en-us/articles/5111216531087-New-Feature-CLO-SET-Viewer-Upload-Option-](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303268953113) ### 3) Group Operator * **Group Operators can only access the Admin Console. In the Admin Console, one can access billing information, user statistics, group settings, and developer page. We recommend assigning your IT or Finance team as Group Operator.** * **Group Operators are non-paying users (Not counted towards group billing).** ### 4) Updates on Editor/Viewer (Dec 2023) * Editors and Viewers permission has been updated - you can now delete and move ONLY those you created. See below for further details on the update. | **Delete** | **Move** | **Copy** ---|---|---|--- **Editor** | Only if Content is created by the user. | Only if Content is created by the user. | All Contents with access **Viewer** | Viewer(Enable Upload) | Viewer (Enable Download) ### <Permission Table by Space> **Open Here for Detailed Permission Table** **Permission Table by Space** --- | **ADMIN** | **COLLABORATOR** | **EDITOR** | **VIEWER** **COMPANY** **Company** | Invite | O | X | - title: Content Copy
content: # **Objective** You can copy a Content to a different Workroom, or within the same Workroom. When Contents are copied, it will bring with it all of the details within. 1. Content Copy 2. Copy Type 3. Copy as Linked Content # # **Details** ### 1) Content Copy * Enter the Workroom in which the desired Content is located. * Select the Content * Select 'Copy' from the floating menu![Screenshot](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778918990489) * Enter the name of the Copy * Select Copy Type, and select the Workroom to generate the Copy in * To make it a Linked Content, turn on the option ### 2)Copy Type ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778919242905) | ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/50931188948889) ---|--- 1. Only Content : Only the selected content file will be copied 2. Copy with Comments/Annotations : The content file along with its comments and annotations will be copied. 3. Copy with Web Tech Pack : The web tech pack data will be copied together. (Comments in the WTP will be copied, but the basic comments and annotations will not be copied.) ### ### 3)Copy as Linked Content ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778919242905) | ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/50944982965529) ---|--- 1. Turn on 'Make a Child Content' option 2. Enter a Memo about the Child Content, and click 'OK' 3. Your will see a Child Content has been created at the selected Workroom 4. From the Parent Content, click on the 'Linked Content' button to view the full list. ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778947550873) *When you create a copy within the same Company space as the original file, **Workflow & Category** information will be copied as well. If not, it will be reset. *When you multi-copy and create Child Content, each copy will be linked to the same garment only. For example, if you select garment A,B,C and copy them with Child Content option, _garment A_ will be linked to the _copy of garment A_ only.
content_description: This web page provides a comprehensive guide on how to copy content between workrooms, including options for linked content and various copy types, ensuring all details are accurately transferred.

title: Change Plan / Unsubscribe
content: # **Objective** Learn how to cancel your Advanced Plan subscription and downgrade to free plan. 1. Change Plan * Upgrade * Downgrade (Unsubscribe) 2. Refund Policy *Before you start: Plan type can only be managed by[ Group Admin or Group Operator](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303153376537). Changing your plan type will affect everyone in your [Group](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303185480985). # **Details** ### 1) Change Plan * To change your plan type, visit [Console - Summary](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303236765721). * Make sure you are in the correct Group. Check the Group name on the top-left corner of your screen. To switch Groups, click on the downward arrow (⌄) next to the Group name. * Click 'Change Plan' on the right to select a new plan. ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778328362905) | ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778328565657) ---|--- ### ⬆️ Upgrade Upgrading will take place **immediately** after the payment is made. 1\. Upgrading from **Standard to Premium** * * Your remaining measurement period for the Standard plan will be refunded in credit form, to be applied automatically for your new Premium plan subscription. * Example) Billing changes when upgrading from Standard to Premium ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778314053401) 1\. Once the upgrading is initiated, your Standard plan subscription will be cancelled. If you had any remaining days under the Standard plan, the unused days will be refunded in the form of credit. * * * In this example, $92.80 has been refunded (for the unused 28 days, for 5 users). This resulted in a total credit balance of $54.24 based on previous bill history (which means that the previous credit balance was -$38.56) 2\. Premium plan subscription created immediately. * * * A new bill is created for 5 users with a charge of $200 ($40 x 5). This resulted in a total credit balance of -$145.76 ($54.24 - $200.00). Negative credit indicates that the user owes the amount to be paid. 3\. Payment completed, and Premium plan subscription started. 2\. Upgrading from **Free to paid plans** (Standard or Premium) * From [Console - Summary](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303236765721), click on 'Subscribe' ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778329034265) * From the [CLO-SET Pricing](https://style.clo-set.com/service/pricing) page, select a plan to subscribe, and follow the [payment process.](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303171146009) ### ⬇️ Downgrade (Unsubscribe) Downgrading will take place on your Group's **next renewal date**. Please note that CLO-SET does not refund the unused days of your monthly subscription once it is initiated. 1\. Downgrading from **Premium to Standard** * Important: Once your Group is downgraded to the Standard plan, there will be restrictions on the Group's usage. Please make sure to review the restrictions to minimize disruption. * Your existing Premium plan subscription will be valid until the end of your measurement period. On your next renewal date, your plan will be changed to Standard. * You **CANNOT** downgrade if your current usage exceeds the plan limit of the Standard plan. Please review your usage on '[Console - Billing - Usage History](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303239183257)' and make changes accordingly. ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778329183129) | ![Pricing Page Modal.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778329308313) ---|--- 2\. Downgrading from **Premium/Standard to Free** * Downgrading will take place on your Group's next renewal date. Please note that CLO-SET does not refund the unused days of your monthly subscription once it is initiated. * If you had pending**negative credit balance** (to be paid) at the point of downgrading, you will be charged for the amount before your subscription is cancelled. ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778329438361) * If you had pending**positive credit balance** at the point of downgrading, or failure of repurchasing, your credit will be 0 upon downgrading to free, and a billing history entry will be created. * For accounts that have already downgraded to Free before August 12, 2025, any existing positive credit will not be removed and remain) ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778302557849) * You **CANNOT** downgrade if your current usage exceeds the plan limit of the Free plan. Please review your usage on '[Console - Billing - Usage History](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303239183257)' and make changes accordingly. ### 2) Refund Policy * Your subscription is valid until the end of Measurement Period, unless there was an upgrade attempt. * Please note that under [CLO-SET TOS](https://style.clo-set.com/policy/terms-of-service), no refunds are made for unused number of days in cash form, unless required by law. * For any inquiries, please [contact us](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/en-us/requests/new).
content_description: This page provides step-by-step instructions for canceling your Advanced Plan subscription and downgrading to a free plan, along with important information about refund policies and plan management.
